day.headline: A Monkey day — Rat and Dragon are in step.

reasons: Dragon and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a voice heard through a wall
signs.message: That voice through the wall sounds familiar. Go find out.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You're done shrinking to fit someone you already outgrew.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Last day off got wasted. Actually leave the apartment.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the yawn that will not finish
signs.message: That half-yawn wants air, not a nap. Go outside.

reasons: Tiger opposes Monkey — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Make it the fussy way today. Four extra minutes, worth it.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Pocket the rock from that trip. Carry it around today.

reasons: Snake pairs with Monkey — a harmonious day
signs.message: Drop to the cheaper tier. Two minutes, nothing lost.

reasons: Monkey's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Those jeans aren't yours anymore. Someone else should have them.

reasons: Rat and Monkey share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the pen about to run out
signs.message: That fading pen still writes. No supply run needed today.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a bag packed the night before
signs.message: Bag's by the door already. Nothing else needs deciding tonight.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the album that fits the weather
signs.message: Put on the album that sounds like this heat. Stay in.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Monkey — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The thought that won't land can stay unlanded. Not homework.
